description: This file defines the AccountSwitcherAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Account objects in an Android application, handling view creation, data binding, and account click events.

classes.name: AccountSwitcherAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for managing and displaying a list of Account objects, with click handling.

methods.name: AccountSwitcherAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a click handler for accounts.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the account at the specified position.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder for an account item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds account data to the ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of accounts in the list.

methods.name: setLocalAccounts
methods.description: Updates the adapter's account list and refreshes the view.
